mapper.sql: id, name, price, stock, version, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product.product (id, name, price, stock, version, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{price}, #{stock}, 0, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM product.product WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = false
SELECT FROM product.product WHERE is_deleted = false AND id IN #{id}
